description: Gate-2 sweep for the late-hour hold that passed thesis_screen (14:00-15:30 admit, 60m / flatten 15:50, n=136, net +0.35% after 20bps, 2.3σ vs eligible-within). Run with --admitted --admit-tod 14:00-15:30 --arm-at-admit --no-book so the entry matches the screen (buy the admission, skip heat/RSI). Baseline is live exits on those same entries — the 0.10R working shelf that closed the 86-second scalp. trail_enabled=false seeds the hard synth stop instead of that shelf. Sim has no spread; a candidate whose mean $ is smaller than ~0.2% of notional is not a trade. Does not write bot_config.json.
